raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Add the opt-in `mi355x_agentx` preset to the MiniMax-M3.1-Flash recipe: the MI355X TP4 AgentX lane from [InferenceX #4671](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4671) on the Quark MXFP4 checkpoint, concurrency 1 to 64.

## Claims

- Adds one preset, scoped to the `mxfp4` variant, with seven concurrency points that the builder can render: 1/2/4/8 (seven-token DSpark with mono decode, FP8 KV cache), 16/32 (seven-token DSpark with DBO, NVFP4 KV cache, 0.85 memory), and 64 (three-token DSpark with DBO and a host-DRAM KV tier through `SimpleCPUOffloadConnector`, 0.90 memory).
- Every point's generated command carries the same serving flags as the InferenceX run for that point.
- The runbook records measured results and two limitations (below).
- No existing rendering changes.

## Validation

From a `vllm-project/recipes` checkout at `d460fcc`, with this branch as the `vllm` source:

```bash
node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir "$VLLM_CHECKOUT/recipes"
node --test scripts/test-guide-html.mjs scripts/test-presets.mjs scripts/test-schema.mjs
pre-commit run typos --files recipes/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.yaml
```

The source validator passes, 47 of 47 renderer tests pass, and `typos` passes. Building the JSON API on `main` and on this branch gives 22,575 identical files; the only differences are the new `presets/mi355x_agentx.json` and the new entry in the two parent JSONs (`MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.json` and the promoted `amd/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Quark-MXFP4.json`).

All seven rendered commands were compared flag by flag with the `vllm serve` commands in the InferenceX job logs. Serving flags and relevant environment variables match at every point, except that the harness flags (`--host`, `--port`, `--device-ids`, `--served-model-name`, `--disable-uvicorn-access-log`, `--max-model-len`, `--trust-remote-code`) are not part of the preset, throughput runs used synthetic rejection where the preset keeps block rejection, and `VLLM_ROCM_MINIMAX_M3_SP_PREFILL=1` (set at concurrency 64 by InferenceX) is omitted because it had no effect on this checkpoint.

Existing GPU evidence, not a new GPU run from this PR: [InferenceX run 41003224750](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41003224750) at `a328b4435` passed all seven performance points and GSM8K at concurrency 8, 32 and 64 (0.964, 0.959, 0.957 strict exact match, 1,319 samples each). Per-point interactivity and throughput are in the runbook (single run).

## Details

**Not a duplicate.** The recipe has presets for B300, GB200 and GB300 but none for MI355X AgentX. Open PRs touching this model are code changes (#64448, #64273), not recipe presets.

**Why the DBO points pass the DBO flags directly.** The `prefill_dbo_sp` feature's modes set their own thresholds (8192, or 16384 with SP on the default checkpoint only) and a feature's flags win over a preset's `args`. This lane runs the 16384-token DBO threshold without SP, so the preset passes `--enable-dbo` and the thresholds itself, with the V2 model runner env the feature would set.

**Limitations, also in the runbook.**
- Concurrency 64 needed a rerun: the first attempt hung at its first load from the host KV tier (23 fetches in progress, none completing, then a `sample_tokens` RPC timeout) and the rerun passed. The offload point is less proven than the others.
- Sequence-parallel prefill does not apply to the Quark checkpoint: the server logged it as off even with the variable set.

AI assistance was used (Claude Sonnet 5.5, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, via Claude Code): it drafted the preset, ran the validation above, and compared the rendered commands with the InferenceX job logs. The submitter reviewed the changes.

files.patch:
@@ -1367,6 +1367,112 @@ presets:
 
       The InferenceX throughput points replaced block verification with synthetic rejection at the committed golden DSpark acceptance length (4.04), so every point is measured at the same acceptance rate. Production serving keeps the default rejection sampler (`rejection_sample_method: block`), as in the command above.
 
+  mi355x_agentx:
+    label: "AgentX TP4"
+    hardware: mi355x
+    strategy: single_node_tp
+    variants: [mxfp4]
+    workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
+    description: "One TP4 engine on four of the node's eight MI355X GPUs, serving the Quark MXFP4 checkpoint: seven-token DSpark with mono decode and an FP8 KV cache up to concurrency 8, seven-token DSpark with DBO and an NVFP4 KV cache at 16 and 32, and three-token DSpark with DBO and a host-DRAM KV tier at 64."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4671", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4671", key: "minimaxm31flash-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark", revision: a328b443582c45e45eef7f0c4f133f3e173f0211 }
+    image: "vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:minimax-m31-flash@sha256:ae8681212aa5291d8c27f06e90016435e3fca144a68fd5c439231f6475f74569"
+    tp: 4
+    select:
+      features: { text_only: true, spec_decoding: true }
+    args:
+      - "--enable-prefix-caching"
+    env:
+      VLLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE: "900"
+    json_args:
+      "--speculative-config": { num_speculative_tokens: 7, rejection_sample_method: block }
+    # The DBO points pass the DBO flags directly: the DBO / SP prefill feature's
+    # modes set their own thresholds (8192, or 16384 with SP on the default
+    # checkpoint only), and this lane runs the 16384-token threshold without SP.
+    points:
+      c1:
+        label: "1 (mono)"
+        concurrency: 1
+        select: { features: { mono_decode: mono } }
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "2", "--max-num-batched-tokens", "8192"]
+      c2:
+        label: "2 (mono)"
+        concurrency: 2
+        select: { features: { mono_decode: mono } }
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "4", "--max-num-batched-tokens", "8192"]
+      c4:
+        label: "4 (mono)"
+        concurrency: 4
+        select: { features: { mono_decode: mono } }
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "8", "--max-num-batched-tokens", "8192"]
+      c8:
+        label: "8 (mono)"
+        concurrency: 8
+        select: { features: { mono_decode: mono } }
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "16", "--max-num-batched-tokens", "8192"]
+      c16:
+        label: "16 (DBO)"
+        concurrency: 16
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "32", "--max-num-batched-tokens", "32768", "--gpu-memory-utilization", "0.85", "--enable-dbo", "--dbo-prefill-token-threshold", "16384", "--dbo-decode-token-threshold", "32768"]
+        env: { VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1", DEBUG_HIP_DYNAMIC_QUEUES: "0" }
+      c32:
+        label: "32 (DBO)"
+        concurrency: 32
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "64", "--max-num-batched-tokens", "32768", "--gpu-memory-utilization", "0.85", "--enable-dbo", "--dbo-prefill-token-threshold", "16384", "--dbo-decode-token-threshold", "32768"]
+        env: { VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1", DEBUG_HIP_DYNAMIC_QUEUES: "0" }
+      c64:
+        label: "64 (DBO, KV offload)"
+        concurrency: 64
+        select: { kv_offload: simple }
+        args: ["--max-num-seqs", "128", "--max-num-batched-tokens", "32768", "--gpu-memory-utilization", "0.9", "--enable-dbo", "--dbo-prefill-token-threshold", "16384", "--dbo-decode-token-threshold", "32768"]
+        env: { VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: "1", DEBUG_HIP_DYNAMIC_QUEUES: "0", PYTHONHASHSEED: "42" }
+        json_args:
+          "--speculative-config": { num_speculative_tokens: 3 }
+          "--kv-transfer-config": { kv_connector_extra_config: { cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank: null, cpu_bytes_to_use: 1349000000000, lazy_offload: false } }
+    runbook: |
+      The MI355X AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/)
+      (`minimaxm31flash-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark`,
+      [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4671](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4671)),
+      on the Quark MXFP4 checkpoint with `--max-num-seqs` at twice the concurrency
+      (c64 admits 128). Throughput runs replaced block verification with synthetic
+      rejection at the committed golden DSpark acceptance length (4.04 for seven
+      tokens, 2.88 for three); the commands above keep block verification.
+
+      - **Concurrency 1-8** run mono decode with an FP8 KV cache and no DBO: a decode
+        step of up to 16 tokens runs each layer as one fused kernel, and prefill steps
+        stay at 8192 tokens.
+      - **Concurrency 16 and 32** run seven-token DSpark with DBO and an NVFP4 KV cache
+        at 0.85 memory utilization, leaving headroom for DBO prefill.
+      - **Concurrency 64** runs three-token DSpark with DBO at 0.90 and adds a host-DRAM
+        KV tier through `SimpleCPUOffloadConnector`, so cached prefixes are not lost
+        once the working set outgrows the GPU KV cache (14.6M tokens at 0.90).
+        `cpu_bytes_to_use` (1,349 GB) is the budget for the whole engine.
+
+      [InferenceX run 41003224750](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41003224750)
+      passed all seven performance points and GSM8K at concurrency 8, 32 and 64 at
+      `a328b4435` (single run):
+
+      | Concurrency | Interactivity p50 / p90 (tokens/s/user) | Total tokens/s per GPU |
+      | --- | ---: | ---: |
+      | 1 | 551.0 / 515.7 | 6,766 |
+      | 2 | 548.9 / 410.4 | 6,918 |
+      | 4 | 546.3 / 395.6 | 9,494 |
+      | 8 | 407.4 / 240.0 | 15,411 |
+      | 16 | 228.6 / 168.3 | 27,275 |
+      | 32 | 172.3 / 115.1 | 54,158 |
+      | 64 | 71.4 / 47.3 | 75,434 |
+
+      GSM8K exact match (strict) over 1319 questions was 0.964 at concurrency 8, 0.959 at
+      32 and 0.957 at 64.
+
+      - **Concurrency 64 needed a rerun.** The first attempt hung at its first load from
+        the host KV tier (23 fetches in progress, none completing; `sample_tokens` RPC
+        timeout) and was rerun once, which passed. Treat the offload point as less
+        proven than the others.
+      - **Sequence-parallel prefill does not apply to this checkpoint.** InferenceX also
+        set `VLLM_ROCM_MINIMAX_M3_SP_PREFILL=1` at concurrency 64, and the server logged
+        sequence-parallel prefill as off; it is omitted here. SP prefill is available on
+        the default checkpoint through the DBO / SP prefill feature.
+
